headline: Sandhar Technologies files financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026
summary: Sandhar Technologies Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This routine regulatory filing provides updated financial data for the company's performance during the quarter. Retail investors holding Sandhar Technologies can review these numbers to assess the company's recent operational performance and earnings health.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data available for shareholder review

headline: Sandhar Technologies invests in Clean Renewable Energy HR 1B
hook: Sandhar expands into renewable energy sector
summary: Sandhar Technologies has announced an investment in Clean Renewable Energy HR 1B Private Limited. The company informed the NSE of this strategic move to diversify its business interests. This investment aligns with the company's broader corporate strategy to enter the renewable energy space. Retail investors should note this shift as it marks a departure from the company's core automotive component manufacturing focus.
why_it_matters: Diversification into green energy may impact long-term growth and risk profile.
